$comment: From analysis/scripts/audio_env.mjs, ffmpeg ebur128 and silencedetect on the reference audio (AAC 48 kHz stereo, 31.409 s).
bed: Voice only. Every inter-phrase gap measures -64 to -85 dB mean with minima near -90 dB, so there is no music bed or room tone. Transient onsets line up with syllables, so no separate SFX layer is detectable.

voice.character: single narrator, close-mic, dry (no reverb), fast confident explainer read

phrases.text: America will borrow over two million dollars.
The U.S. national debt is now over forty trillion dollars.
That's about a hundred and seventeen thousand dollars for every American.
It took over two centuries to reach twenty trillion,
and under nine years to hit forty.
The real problem is the interest.
It's now over a trillion dollars a year,
more than we spend on defense. By 2048,
it's projected to be the government's biggest bill,
We're not paying for the future.

phraseTextConfidence: Reconstructed from on-screen words and phrase timing; not transcribed. Run elevenlabs speech-to-text on the reference once a key is set to confirm.
syncRules: Visual word appears 0-3 frames before or on its spoken onset.
Emphasis words (bold + highlighter) land exactly on the stressed syllable.
Big numbers start their mask-rise on the first syllable of the number.
Scene transitions start in the pause before the next phrase.
